statement: Every person carrying on business in Hong Kong must apply to the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for business registration within 1 month of the commencement of the business (Business Registration Ordinance section 5(2)); for a company incorporated under the Companies Ordinance the application is made simultaneously with the incorporation submission under the one-stop arrangement (section 5A), so the business registration certificate issues together with the certificate of incorporation.
caveat: The business registration number on the certificate serves as the company's tax file reference with the Inland Revenue Department. Certificates renew on a 1-year or elected 3-year cycle against the prescribed fee and levy, and branch registrations carry their own certificates.
